id: 17_Safe Working Distance From Overhead Electrical Transmission Line Electrical Safe
title: 离高压线远一点
source_doc: course/Electrical Safety Series/17_Safe Working Distance From Overhead Electrical Transmission Line Electrical Safe.md
author_source: project/Electrical Safety Series/17_Safe Working Distance From Overhead Electrical Transmission Line Electrical Safe/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣站在校园草坪上，远处是输电铁塔和架空线，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands on a campus lawn with transmission towers and overhead power lines in the distance and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 你好！今天聊聊头顶上的高压线。

shots.scene: 铁塔、闪电、距离箭头三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a transmission tower, a lightning bolt and a double-headed distance arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 它有多危险，要离多远？

shots.scene: 阿杰扛着一根长长的铝合金采样杆走在路边，上方有电线
shots.prompt_en: The young male student carries a long aluminum sampling pole on his shoulder along a roadside, with power lines overhead.
shots.narration: 阿杰扛着长采样杆去野外实习。

shots.scene: 杆子一头慢慢翘起，接近头顶电线
shots.prompt_en: The end of the long pole tilts upward and gets close to the overhead power line.
shots.narration: 杆子一翘，离电线越来越近。

shots.scene: 小研大喊着跑来，阿杰赶紧放平杆子
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student shouts and runs over, and the young male student quickly lowers the pole flat.
shots.narration: 小研一声喊，阿杰赶紧放平。

shots.scene: 欣欣出现，指着上方的电线
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot appears and points up at the overhead lines.
shots.narration: 欣欣说：高压线，离远一点！

shots.scene: 欣欣站在三座不同高度的铁塔图标前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of three transmission tower icons of increasing height.
shots.narration: 输电线路按电压分等级。

shots.scene: 较矮的铁塔图标亮起
shots.prompt_en: The shortest transmission tower icon lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 第一级叫高压线路，电压已经很高。

shots.scene: 中等高度的铁塔图标亮起，闪电变大
shots.prompt_en: The middle transmission tower icon lights up and its lightning bolt grows bigger. No people.
shots.narration: 更高一级，叫超高压线路。

shots.scene: 最高的铁塔图标亮起，闪电最大
shots.prompt_en: The tallest transmission tower icon lights up with the biggest lightning bolt. No people.
shots.narration: 再往上，是特高压线路。

shots.scene: 空白标准手册图标
shots.prompt_en: A closed standards handbook with a blank cover. No people.
shots.narration: 怎么分级，以国家现行标准为准。

shots.scene: 架空线下画出一圈半透明的禁入区
shots.prompt_en: A translucent keep-out zone drawn around an overhead power line. No people.
shots.narration: 架空线周围，有一圈不能进的范围。

shots.scene: 人形图标停在禁入区边界外
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram stops outside the boundary of the keep-out zone. No people.
shots.narration: 人和工具，都要留在圈外。

shots.scene: 三条线路图标，禁入区一圈比一圈大
shots.prompt_en: Three power line icons whose keep-out zones grow larger with each one. No people.
shots.narration: 电压越高，要离得越远。

shots.scene: 老李拿着空白规程手册对照
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks a blank safety regulation handbook.
shots.narration: 具体距离，按现行规程执行。

shots.scene: 距离表格图标，格子全部空白
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a table with blank cells next to a transmission tower. No people.
shots.narration: 不同电压，距离各不相同。

shots.scene: 起重机吊臂伸向架空线的图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a crane boom reaching toward an overhead power line, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 最常见的事故：吊臂碰到电线。

shots.scene: 电流沿吊臂传到车身，地面出现一圈圈波纹
shots.prompt_en: Current runs down the crane boom into the vehicle body, and ripples spread on the ground around it. No people.
shots.narration: 电会沿着机械传下来，

shots.scene: 周围站着的人形图标都被闪电波及
shots.prompt_en: Person pictograms standing around the crane are reached by lightning symbols. No people.
shots.narration: 旁边站着的人也会受伤。

shots.scene: 长杆尚未碰到电线，中间跳出一道电弧
shots.prompt_en: A long pole has not yet touched the power line, but an electric arc jumps across the gap. No people.
shots.narration: 高压线不用碰到，靠近也会放电。

shots.scene: 欣欣摇手示意别靠近
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves her paw in warning.
shots.narration: 所以不能凑近“试试看”。

shots.scene: 长梯、钓鱼竿、采样杆三个图标靠近电线，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a long ladder, a fishing rod and a sampling pole near an overhead line, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 长梯、钓竿、采样杆，远离电线。

shots.scene: 两个学生把长梯放平抬着走
shots.prompt_en: Two students carry a long ladder horizontally, low and level.
shots.narration: 搬长东西，放平了走，先抬头看。

shots.scene: 风筝和无人机靠近电线的图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a kite and a small drone near power lines, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 放风筝、飞无人机，选空旷处。

shots.scene: 一根电线断落在地面上，冒着火花
shots.prompt_en: A broken power line lies on the ground giving off sparks. No people.
shots.narration: 看到电线断落在地，千万别靠近。

shots.scene: 人形图标双脚并拢小步离开
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram moves away from the fallen line with feet together in small steps. No people.
shots.narration: 已在附近，双脚并拢小步离开。

shots.scene: 小研远远地打电话，旁边有保卫处图标
shots.prompt_en: Standing far away, the female graduate student makes a phone call, with a campus security office icon beside her.
shots.narration: 设专人看守，报告保卫处和供电部门。

shots.scene: 攀爬电杆、铁塔、变压器台的图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a person climbing a utility pole, a transmission tower and a transformer platform, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 电杆、铁塔、变压器，不攀爬。

shots.scene: 铁塔底部挂着当心触电和禁止攀登标志
shots.prompt_en: Electric shock warning and no climbing signs fixed at the base of a transmission tower. No people.
shots.narration: 看到警示标志，绕开走。

shots.scene: 校园施工的吊车停在电线附近，老李拦下
shots.prompt_en: On campus, the facility engineer stops a crane that has parked near overhead lines.
shots.narration: 车辆机械要靠近线路作业，

shots.scene: 老李和保卫处值班员审阅空白申请表
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer and the security officer review a blank application form.
shots.narration: 先报批，由供电部门停电或防护。

shots.scene: 专人在地面监护，手举停止手势
shots.prompt_en: A spotter on the ground raises a hand in a stop signal while a crane works far from the power line.
shots.narration: 作业时还要专人监护。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在铁塔图标前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a transmission tower icon.
shots.narration: 高压线分等级，电压越高越危险。

shots.scene: 禁入区和距离箭头图标
shots.prompt_en: A keep-out zone icon with a distance arrow around a power line. No people.
shots.narration: 人、工具、机械，都要离得够远。

shots.scene: 长杆放平、断线绕行、禁止攀登三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a pole carried flat, a person avoiding a fallen line and a no climbing sign. No people.
shots.narration: 长物放平，断线远离，不攀爬。

shots.scene: 欣欣、小研和放平长杆的阿杰一起挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye with the female graduate student and the young male student, who holds the pole flat.
shots.narration: 抬头看一眼，安全多一分，下次见！
